notes: Today-tab fix (v1.11.50). Part 1: ALL of today's tasks show from the start — the «show more» collapse is gone (attachCollapsible(el, '.part', 4) removed from renderToday; the function and the showMore/showLess keys stay for the other lists); the list scrolls INSIDE one card (#todayBoxes.today-scroll: surface card, 560px height cap, themed scrollbar, sticky day-tick header, opaque so cards do not show through); few tasks and the empty state are unchanged. Part 2: crash on task-field save — the probe reproduced the exact symptom (edit -> save -> half-built page) with 7 distinct malformed shapes, all in the save->renderAll path: null state.done (boot crash in isDone), null state.tests/tests_total (save crash in saveBoxTests), number/string tests entries (strict-mode throw on property assignment), null testLog entries (boot crash in chapterFreshness), null box start/end (every render in minutesBetween) and null box date (render crash in anDailySeries). Root cause: renderAll had try/finally but NO catch, so any throw in any of its ~15 renderers propagated out of the synchronous saveState(); renderAll(); sequence and left the DOM half-built; and a second flushSaves declaration (beacon version) shadowed the async F2 version, so refreshDataFromServer never drained the save queue — F2's fix was dead code in production. Fixes: client-side state normalizer ensureStateMaps() (mirrors the server's sanitize rules in memory: null/wrong-typed maps become {}, bad tests entries/done ticks/numeric entries dropped, non-dict log entries filtered) run on every state load, every refresh and at the top of renderAll; guards at every proven throw site (isDone/doneDate/setDone, saveBoxTests/setBoxTests entry normalization, minutesBetween coercion, anDailySeries/anWeeklySeries null-date skip, all testLog iterations, efSave/applyServerBox/move-to-gap/assignment-total writes); flushSavesBeacon rename so the async F2 flushSaves stays canonical; renderAll now catches and falls back to the Today list alone with a toast (new i18n key renderFailed, fa==en 1224/1224); renderToday renders each card in its own try/catch so one bad box cannot kill the list; linkedTopicIdCached now accepts box objects (the three save paths passed bare ids, so every box save logged topic: null — per-chapter trends lost the attribution). No backend change (the server already sanitizes state on load/save); the exact bad value in the user's real state.json could not be pinned down from the sandbox (it lives on his laptop), so the fix is defensive hardening at every proven site plus the renderAll catch. No other feature changed.
